Each time we sell a Hyundai, a portion goes to Hyundai Hope On Wheels®
to help find a cure for childhood cancer. Over the last 26 years, Hyundai
Hope On Wheels has donated $250 million to pediatric cancer research.
Hope is our greatest feature. And it comes standard on every Hyundai.
For more information, please visit HyundaiHopeOnWheels.org.
